sn1.29:1.1: These verses, with a brief setting, are also at [sn2.28:2.1](). | The “nine doors” are the nine apertures of the body (compare the eleven doors at [mn52:15.5]()).
sn1.29:1.4: The phrase _yātrā bhavissati_ is familiar from the mendicant’s reflection on eating. only so that they “will keep going”. The problem here is that the body is bound up with suffering.
